scans.answer_at_t_val: The extra correction is a triangle (triangular wedge). Its base is x-a. Its height is the change of the white graph from a to x, approximated by that graph's slope at a times x-a; because the white graph is f_area', this is f_area''(a)(x-a). Thus its area is one half of base times height, giving (1/2)f_area''(a)(x-a)^2.
